title: Multi-omics analysis reveals Yishen Qutong formula promotes ferroptosis in Lewis lung cancer associated with Keap1/Nrf2/Nqo1 pathway modulation.
authors: Li, Sicong; Cui, Yiyuan; Zheng, Sujuan; Yan, Yijing; Jin, Yue; Chen, Yufan; Yu, Jingjie; Li, Yi; Feng, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过Keap1/Nrf2/Nqo1通路促进肺癌铁死亡，仅涉及分子对接且非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Yishen Qutong Formula (YSQTF) is composed of six ingredients of Liuwei Dihuang, a classical traditional Chinese medicine fomula, plus Drynaria fortunei (Kunze) J. Sm., Bombyx Batryticatus, Hedyotis diffusa Willd, Scutellaria barbata D. Don. YSQTF has been proved effective in clinical practice of cancer pain. However, its role and mechanisms for anti-tumor activity remain unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: The objective of this research is to identify the principal constituents, pivotal targets, and possible therapeutic mechanisms of YSQTF in the Lewis lung cancer treatment. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Widely targeted metabolomics was used to identify the serum components in YSQTF. Using network pharmacology, we identified potential YSQTF targets and conducted enrichment analysis on them. Subsequently, we investigated the regulatory effects of YSQTF on the Keap1/Nrf2 pathway and ferroptosis in lewis lung cancer cells through RT-qPCR, Western blot and single cell sequencing. We used untargeted metabolomics to evaluate the regulatory effect of YSQTF-containing serum on the metabolism of Lewis cells. Finally, we investigated the potential serum component regulating Keap1/Nrf2 pathway through molecular docking analysis. RESULTS: The study identified 39 compounds as YSQTF serum components and predicted 550 genes as their potential targets. In vitro, three concentrations of YSQTF (10%, 20%, and 30% serum) dose-dependently upregulated Keap1 while suppressing Nrf2 and Nqo1 in lewis cells. In vivo, three doses of YSQTF (2.21, 4.42 or 6.63 g/kg) exerted similar dose-dependent effects on these proteins in tumor tissues. These changes collectively promoted ferroptosis, as evidenced by elevated iron, MDA, 4-HNE, and ROS levels, alongside decreased GSH, GSSG, and GSH/GSSG ratios in both cellular and animal models. 3-hydroxycinnamic acid in YSQTF exhibited potential regulatory effects on Keap1. CONCLUSION: YSQTF promoted ferroptosis in Lewis lung cancer, which was associated with the Keap1/Nrf2/Nqo1 pathway. 3-hydroxycinnamic acid might be a serum component in YSQTF regulating the expression of Keap1.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：益肾祛痛方（YSQTF）由经典中药方剂六味地黄丸的六味药材，加上骨碎补（Drynaria fortunei (Kunze) J. Sm.）、僵蚕（Bombyx Batryticatus）、白花蛇舌草（Hedyotis diffusa Willd）、半枝莲（Scutellaria barbata D. Don）组成。YSQTF在癌痛的临床实践中已被证明有效。然而，其抗肿瘤活性的作用和机制仍不清楚。研究目的：本研究的目的是鉴定YSQTF在Lewis肺癌治疗中的主要成分、关键靶点及可能的治疗机制。材料与方法：采用广泛靶向代谢组学鉴定YSQTF中的血清成分。通过网络药理学，我们确定了YSQTF的潜在靶点并对其进行了富集分析。随后，我们通过RT-qPCR、Western blot和单细胞测序研究了YSQTF对Lewis肺癌细胞中Keap1/Nrf2通路和铁死亡（ferroptosis）的调节作用。我们使用非靶向代谢组学评估含YSQTF血清对Lewis细胞代谢的调节作用。最后，我们通过分子对接分析研究了可能调节Keap1/Nrf2通路的血清成分。结果：研究鉴定出39种化合物作为YSQTF血清成分，并预测了550个基因作为其潜在靶点。在体外，三种浓度的YSQTF（10%、20%和30%血清）剂量依赖性地上调Lewis细胞中的Keap1，同时抑制Nrf2和Nqo1。在体内，三种剂量的YSQTF（2.21、4.42或6.63 g/kg）对肿瘤组织中的这些蛋白产生了类似的剂量依赖性效应。这些变化共同促进了铁死亡，表现为细胞和动物模型中铁、MDA、4-HNE和ROS水平升高，同时GSH、GSSG及GSH/GSSG比值降低。YSQTF中的3-羟基肉桂酸对Keap1表现出潜在的调节作用。结论：YSQTF促进了Lewis肺癌中的铁死亡，这与Keap1/Nrf2/Nqo1通路相关。3-羟基肉桂酸可能是YSQTF中调节Keap1表达的血清成分。
